paragraphs: Ami bar Shmuel, Niddah 26b. Chanina bar Shmuel, Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah ch. 1, halakha 1.
Rav Yehuda bar Shmuel, Shabbat 38a. Levi bar Shmuel, Shabbat 47a.
Rav Papa bar Shmuel, Shabbat 54b. Rava bar Shmuel, Berakhot 22b. Rabbah bar Shmuel, Berakhot 28a. Ravin bar Shmuel, Bava Batra 43a. Rami bar Shmuel, Ketubot 96a.

notes.text: This is a collective index of sages with the patronymic bar Shmuel, not a claim that they shared one father.
